text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Carefully optimizing your trainee's workload while managing her motivation with friendly banter…

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: It's amazing! Simply amazing! You must be the greatest trainer in history! I'm so blessed to be a reporter in this era!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: But I can't stand here mesmerized—I must go back to the office and write this article at once!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: I'll title it, "Top Tracen Trainer Gives All for Beloved Umamusume!"
